name: @ship/sail-site
description: The SAIL docs site — a deck app: docs, the 25-lesson tutorial, the component library, and an interactive component playground. SAIL's own red identity, light + dark.

scripts.gen: (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p sail-compiler -- prop-registry) && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- build-assets) && (cp ../../packages/sail/compiler-wasm/pkg/sail_compiler_bg.wasm public/sail_compiler_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null || true) && node scripts/gen-tut-preview-theme.mjs
scripts.dev: bun run gen && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- dev --project apps/sail-site --addr 127.0.0.1:7878)
scripts.build: bun run gen && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- build --project apps/sail-site --base assets --bundle-framework)
